title: SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking
title_zh: SAM3RL：通过强化学习实现视觉目标跟踪的记忆控制

paragraphs.en: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12 tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks, outperforming all hand-crafted rules without any runtime overhead. The same approach applied to SAM 2 gives SAM2RL, which outperforms hand-crafted rules on 9 of the 12 benchmarks, showing the generality of our method across model generations.
paragraphs.zh: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) 是一种用于图像和视频分割的基础模型，在视觉目标跟踪领域达到了当前最先进的水平。 其跟踪器继承自 SAM 2，将过往帧的信息存储在一个记忆库中，并通过简单的先进先出规则进行管理，从而在复杂视频中保持时间上的一致性。 近期的一些方法通过手工设计的记忆更新规则对 SAM 2 进行了改进，每种方法都针对特定的失效模式，例如干扰物、遮挡或目标运动。 然而，这些改进所带来的提升仅能部分迁移到性能更强的 SAM 3 主干模型上。 我们提出了一种更具通用性且以数据驱动的方法，将记忆控制框架化为一个序列决策任务。 SAM3RL 是 SAM 3 跟踪器的扩展版本，它配备了一个轻量级的记忆控制器，通过强化学习进行训练，能够决定哪些帧应被存入记忆库，以最大化跟踪性能。 SAM3RL 在 12 个跟踪和视频目标分割基准测试中的 10 项上达到了新的先进水平，且无需任何运行时开销便超越了所有手工设计的规则。 将相同的方法应用于 SAM 2 后得到了 SAM2RL，它在 12 个基准测试中的 9 项上优于手工设计的规则，证明了该方法在不同代模型间的通用性。

paragraphs.en: Visual object tracking is a fundamental computer vision task in which a tracker is given a target object in the first frame of a video and must localize it, as a box or a segmentation mask, in all subsequent frames. Reliable tracking is a key component of applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, video surveillance, and sports analytics ( Marvasti-Zadeh et al., 2022 ) . The task remains difficult since the target may be surrounded by visually similar distractors, be occluded for long periods, or change its appearance. These challenges are amplified in long videos, where errors can accumulate over time and recovery depends critically on historical context ( Javed et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视觉目标跟踪是一项基础的计算机视觉任务，其中跟踪器在视频的第一帧中被给定一个目标对象，并必须在所有后续帧中以边界框或分割掩码的形式定位该目标。 可靠的跟踪是自动驾驶、机器人技术、视频监控和体育分析等应用的关键组成部分（Marvasti-Zadeh 等人，2022）。 这项任务仍然具有挑战性，因为目标可能被视觉上相似的干扰物包围，长时间被遮挡，或者其外观发生变化。 在长视频中，这些挑战会被进一步放大，因为错误会随时间累积，而恢复则严重依赖历史上下文（Javed 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Recent state-of-the-art trackers are built on the Segment Anything Model (SAM) family. SAM 2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) is a promptable video segmentation model that conditions each mask prediction on features from past frames held in a small, fixed-size memory bank . SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) targets promptable concept segmentation, while inheriting the tracker architecture from SAM 2. The original SAM 2 populates the bank with a simple First-In-First-Out (FIFO) rule that keeps the most recent frames regardless of quality or relevance. Therefore, a line of follow-up work replaces FIFO with hand-crafted update rules, including motion-aware frame selection ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , distractor-aware memory ( Videnović et al., 2026 ) , and calibrated prototype memory with positional priors ( Xu et al., 2025 ) ; some go further and also select among mask candidates by motion consistency ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) or maintain several banks and search over them ( Ding et al., 2025b ) . SAM 3 also follows this approach and refines FIFO by keeping only frames in which the object is not occluded, plus the most recent frame.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的顶尖追踪器均基于 Segment Anything Model（SAM）系列模型构建。 SAM 2（Ravi 等，2025）是一种支持提示的视频分割模型，其每个掩码预测都以存储于小型固定尺寸记忆库中的过往帧特征为条件。 SAM 3（Carion 等，2026）专注于支持提示的概念分割，同时继承了 SAM 2 的追踪器架构。 原始 SAM 2 采用简单的先进先出（FIFO）规则填充该记忆库，无论帧的质量或相关性如何，均保留最新帧。 因此，一系列后续研究用人工设计的更新规则替代了 FIFO，包括基于运动感知进行帧选择（Yang 等，2026；Chen 等，2026）、考虑干扰项的记忆机制（Videnović 等，2026），以及结合位置先验的校准原型记忆（Xu 等，2025）；部分研究更进一步，通过运动一致性选择掩码候选（Yang 等，2026；Chen 等，2026），或维护多个记忆库并在其中进行搜索（Ding 等，2025b）。 SAM 3 也遵循这一方法，并通过仅保留物体未被遮挡的帧以及最新帧来优化 FIFO。

paragraphs.en: However, each of the hand-crafted rules targets a particular failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or fast motion. Ideally, the tracker should be robust to all of them at the same time. Moreover, these rules are tied to the model generation they were designed for, as all heuristics developed for SAM 2 transfer poorly to the stronger SAM 3. Their gains on tracking benchmarks are limited, and on video object segmentation they even fall below SAM 3 on most benchmarks; see Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，每一条人工制定的规则都针对特定的失效模式，例如干扰物、遮挡或快速运动。 理想情况下，追踪器应能同时抵抗所有这些失效模式。 此外，这些规则与其设计所依赖的模型生成过程紧密相关，因为为 SAM 2 开发的所有启发式方法都难以有效迁移到更强大的 SAM 3 上。 它们在追踪基准测试上的提升有限，在视频目标分割方面，大多数基准测试中的表现甚至低于 SAM 3；参见图 1。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we show that memory control should be learned rather than designed. We formulate memory control as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), designing the state, actions, and reward, but leaving the choice of what to remember to the agent. That choice is learned by reinforcement learning (RL) directly from data, without touching the tracker itself. We introduce SAM3RL , which applies this memory control formulation to SAM 3 and sets a new state of the art on several tracking benchmarks, most notably on the VOTS and VOT-LT challenges. It does so at no additional inference cost and, unlike hand-crafted rules, without sacrificing performance on video object segmentation. Applied to SAM 2, the same recipe yields SAM2RL, which still outperforms hand-crafted rules on most benchmarks, showing the generality of our learned method across model generations.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们证明了记忆控制应当通过学习而非设计来实现。 我们将记忆控制建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），设计了状态、动作和奖励机制，但将“记住什么”的选择权交给了智能体。 这一选择由强化学习（RL）直接从数据中学习，而无需改动追踪器本身。 我们提出了 SAM3RL，它将这种记忆控制方法应用于 SAM 3，并在多个追踪基准测试中达到了新的先进水平，尤其是在 VOTS 和 VOT-LT 挑战中表现突出。 这种方法不会增加额外的推理成本，并且与手工设计的规则不同，它并未牺牲视频目标分割的性能。 将相同的方法应用于 SAM 2，可得到 SAM2RL，它在大多数基准测试中仍优于手工设计的规则，证明了我们的学习方法在不同模型版本中的通用性。

paragraphs.en: Learned memory control for SAM-based trackers. We formulate memory bank control in SAM-based trackers as an MDP over a fixed-capacity bank. The state describes the content of the bank, the action selects the entry to evict, and the reward scores the resulting prediction against the annotation. This formulation allows the memory control to be learned instead of being manually designed.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 SAM 的跟踪器的学习化记忆控制。 我们将基于 SAM 的跟踪器中的记忆库控制问题，建模为在固定容量记忆库上的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。 状态描述了记忆库的内容，动作选择要移除的记忆项，而奖励则根据预测结果与标注的对比进行评分。 这种建模方式使得记忆控制可以通过学习获得，而非手动设计。

sents.zh: 基于 SAM 的跟踪器的学习化记忆控制。

paragraphs.en: State-of-the-art visual object tracker. We present SAM3RL, which extends SAM 3 with a memory controller obtained by optimizing the introduced MDP with RL. It improves over SAM 3 on 11 out of 12 benchmarks and ranks first on 10 of them. The largest gains are achieved on the VOT(S) challenges, with + 3.6 +3.6 on VOTS 2026 {}_{\text{2026}} and + 5.5 +5.5 on VOT-LT 2022 {}_{\text{2022}} . It is also the only tracker that consistently succeeds in video object segmentation, scoring + 1.1 +1.1 on MOSE v2 {}_{\text{v2}} and + 2.5 +2.5 on SA-V val {}_{\text{val}} . SAM3RL achieves this while optimizing the memory control only, whereas most compared methods additionally modify mask selection, prompting, or the number of banks maintained.

paragraphs.en: Online controller without a runtime penalty. The SAM3RL controller is a lightweight MLP evaluated once per memory update. It reads only values the tracker has already computed, and stays fully online without lookahead or extra feature extraction, unlike other methods. On tracking benchmarks, SAM3RL is faster than SAM 3, at 16.0 FPS against 15.3 FPS, as the memory is updated only every sixth frame, matching the decision rate used in training. Under the real-time FPS constraint of VOTS-RT 2025 {}_{\text{2025}} , SAM3RL stays best at 75.1 75.1 , dropping only 1.8 1.8 points, while SAM 3 drops 4.3 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在线控制器，无运行时开销。 SAM3RL 控制器是一个轻量级 MLP，每次内存更新时仅评估一次。 它只读取追踪器已计算出的值，且完全在线运行，无需前瞻或额外的特征提取，与其他方法不同。 在追踪基准测试中，SAM3RL 比 SAM 3 更快，帧率分别为 16.0 FPS 和 15.3 FPS，因为内存仅在每六帧中更新一次，与训练时使用的决策频率一致。 在 VOTS-RT 2025 {}_{\text{2025}} 的实时帧率约束下，SAM3RL 仍保持最佳性能，为 75.1 75.1，仅下降 1.8 1.8 分，而 SAM 3 则下降了 4.3 4.3 分。

paragraphs.en: Visual object tracking (VOT) and semi-supervised video object segmentation (VOS) are conditioned on a target specified in the first frame of a video, which must then be localized in all subsequent frames. The target is represented by a bounding box in VOT and a pixel-level mask in VOS. Both tasks require maintaining the target through appearance changes, occlusions, fast motion, and distractors, which remain the dominant sources of tracking failure ( Kristan et al., 2020 ) . To address these challenges, trackers have long exploited information from previous frames ( Matthews et al., 2004 ; Kalal et al., 2012 ; Oh et al., 2019 ; Cui et al., 2022 ; Han and Huang, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视觉目标跟踪（VOT）和半监督视频目标分割（VOS）都以视频中第一帧指定的目标为条件，随后必须在所有后续帧中定位该目标。 在 VOT 中，目标由一个边界框表示；而在 VOS 中，则由一个像素级掩码表示。 这两项任务都需要在目标外观发生变化、被遮挡、快速移动以及存在干扰因素的情况下持续跟踪目标，而这些因素仍然是导致跟踪失败的主要原因（Kristan et al., 2020）。 为应对这些挑战，跟踪器长期以来一直利用先前帧中的信息（Matthews et al., 2004；Kalal et al., 2012；Oh et al., 2019；Cui et al., 2022；Han and Huang, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Recently, the SAM 2 foundation model ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) set a new state of the art in tracking. Its impact is evident in the VOTS 2026 {}_{\text{2026}} challenge, where 92% of submitted trackers were derived from the SAM family ( Kristan et al., 2026 ) . Central to the SAM 2 design is the memory bank, a fixed-capacity store of past frames on which every prediction is conditioned by memory attention. The bank holds seven slots, the prompted first frame and the six most recent ones, under a FIFO rule. Because adjacent frames are highly correlated, FIFO tends to fill the bank with redundant observations rather than the diverse history required to distinguish the target from distractors or recover after occlusions.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，SAM 2 基础模型（Ravi 等人，2025）在跟踪领域树立了新的行业标杆。 其影响在 VOTS 2026 {}_{\text{2026}} 挑战赛中显而易见：参赛的跟踪器中，有 92% 源自 SAM 系列模型（Kristan 等人，2026）。 SAM 2 设计的核心是记忆库——一个容量固定的历史帧存储单元，所有预测都通过记忆注意力机制依赖该库中的信息。 该记忆库设有七个槽位：一个由提示指定的首帧和六个最新帧，遵循先进先出（FIFO）规则管理。 由于相邻帧之间高度相关，FIFO 机制往往会用冗余的观察数据填满记忆库，而非存储区分目标与干扰物或恢复被遮挡状态所需的历史多样性信息。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, memory design in SAM-based trackers has become an active research area, with follow-up work replacing FIFO with hand-crafted selection rules. SAMURAI ( Yang et al., 2026 ) uses a Kalman filter ( Kalman, 1960 ) to score motion consistency, both selecting among per-frame mask candidates and gating memory updates. DAM4SAM ( Videnović et al., 2026 ) splits the bank into a fixed-interval part and a part reserved for frames that resolve visually similar distractors. SAMITE ( Xu et al., 2025 ) calibrates stored prototypes and adds positional priors. HiM2SAM ( Chen et al., 2026 ) combines hierarchical motion estimation with a long- and short-term split of the bank. SAM2Long ( Ding et al., 2025b ) keeps several banks in parallel and performs tree search over alternative trajectories. Even SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) relies on such a rule, retaining an unprompted frame only when the model is confident that the target is present.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，基于 SAM 的跟踪器中的内存设计已成为一个活跃的研究领域，后续工作用人工设计的选择规则取代了 FIFO。 SAMURAI（Yang 等，2026）使用卡尔曼滤波器（Kalman，1960）来评估运动一致性，既在每帧的掩码候选中做出选择，也对内存更新进行门控控制。 DAM4SAM（Videnović 等，2026）将内存银行分为固定间隔部分和为解决视觉相似干扰项的帧保留的部分。 SAMITE（Xu 等，2025）对存储的原型进行校准，并添加位置先验信息。 HiM2SAM（Chen 等，2026）将分层运动估计与内存银行的长期和短期划分相结合。 SAM2Long（Ding 等，2025b）并行保留多个内存银行，并对替代轨迹进行树搜索。 甚至 SAM 3（Carion 等，2026）也依赖此类规则，仅当模型确信目标存在时才会保留未经提示的帧。

There, we showed the potential of learned memory control by fitting a separate RL agent to each of a handful of training videos. Agents improve over the hand-crafted rules, but do not transfer to unseen videos. This demonstrates a performance upper bound rather than a usable tracker. Here, we develop the full method, a single general-purpose policy that generalizes to unseen videos, extends to SAM 3, and sets a new state of the art in visual object tracking.

paragraphs.en: Training data. We train on the LaSOT training split ( Fan et al., 2019 ) , whose 1,120 sequences are divided into 896 for training and 224 for validation, while the official test set is held out. LaSOT is annotated with per-frame bounding boxes at 30 FPS. Since consecutive frames at that rate are nearly identical, an eviction decision changes the bank very little while still consuming a decision step. We therefore subsample every sixth frame, so that training episodes run at 5 FPS and span 425 decision steps on average. This also matches the typical annotation rate of VOS datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据。 我们在 LaSOT 训练集（Fan et al., 2019）上进行训练，其中 1,120 个序列被分为 896 个用于训练和 224 个用于验证，而官方测试集则单独保留。 LaSOT 以每秒 30 帧的速率标注了每一帧的边界框。 由于该速率下连续帧几乎完全相同，因此驱逐决策对银行的影响极小，但仍会消耗一个决策步骤。 因此，我们对每第六帧进行子采样，使得训练回合以每秒 5 帧的速率运行，平均包含 425 个决策步骤。 这也与 VOS 数据集的典型标注速率相符。

paragraphs.en: Optimization. We train the controller with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) , using the undiscounted Monte-Carlo return (i.e. , γ = 1 \gamma=1 ) minus the critic’s predicted value as the advantage. The return is bootstrapped only when the rollout window truncates an episode, corresponding to λ = 1 \lambda=1 in generalized advantage estimation (GAE) ( Schulman et al., 2016 ) . Apart from this bootstrap, we keep the critic out of the targets and use it only as a baseline, as it fits the training videos well but transfers poorly to unseen videos. Each of the 400 iterations collects 376-step rollouts from 256 parallel environments. Training takes about 24 hours on four H200 GPUs. We evaluate the greedy policy on the full validation videos every 25 iterations and select the best checkpoint. All remaining hyperparameters are listed in Table 13 in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 优化。 我们使用近端策略优化（PPO）（Schulman 等，2017）训练控制器，其中优势函数为未折扣的蒙特卡洛回报（即 γ = 1 \gamma=1）减去评论家预测的值。 仅当展开窗口截断一个回合时，回报才会进行自举，这对应于广义优势估计（GAE）（Schulman 等，2016）中的 λ = 1 \lambda=1。 除了这种自举机制外，我们将评论家排除在目标之外，仅将其用作基线，因为它能很好地拟合训练视频，但难以迁移到未见的视频。 在 400 次迭代中，每次迭代都会从 256 个并行环境中收集 376 步的展开数据。 在四块 H200 GPU 上，训练大约需要 24 小时。 我们每 25 次迭代就在完整的验证视频上评估贪心策略，并选择最佳检查点。 所有其余超参数均列于附录 D 中的表 13。

paragraphs.en: SAM3RL sets a new state of the art among memory control methods for SAM-based trackers on most tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks. In this section, we compare it with the prior methods discussed in Section 2 , all evaluated on the SAM 3 backbone. Because these methods were designed for SAM 2 and their authors have not released SAM 3 implementations, we port each one to SAM 3 ourselves. Each port replaces the SAM 2 video predictor with the SAM 3 tracker and leaves the method otherwise untouched. We also compare the prior methods, in their original SAM 2 implementations, against SAM2RL (our memory control on SAM 2) in Figure 1 and Appendix A . Appendix B details tracker evaluation, FPS measurement, reproducibility, and the ports.

paragraphs.en: The VOT initiative has organized annual tracking challenges for over a decade, and its benchmarks have evolved with the field ( Kristan et al., 2013 ) . Current VOTS challenges unify short-term and long-term tracking with single-target and multi-target scenarios. The sequences feature occlusions, visually similar distractors, and targets that leave the field of view and re-enter. VOTS targets are annotated by segmentation masks and scored on a remote server, whereas VOT-LT targets are annotated by bounding boxes. Results are presented in Table 1 . On the 30 FPS benchmarks, SAM3RL updates its memory only every s s th frame with s = 6 s=6 , matching the 5 FPS data used during training. paragraphs.en: Memory stride. Deciding on every frame is the most flexible choice in principle, but training at 30 FPS is costly, as most decisions concern nearly identical frames. We therefore train at 5 FPS and match that decision rate at inference with the stride s s . Table 4 shows the effect of stride on 30 FPS benchmarks. At s = 1 s=1 , our policy runs outside its training distribution, yet still outperforms SAM 3 on all seven benchmarks, by 1.8 points on average. At s = 6 s=6 , although only every sixth frame can enter the bank, the gain grows to 2.9 points as the decision rate matches the 5 FPS used in training. In our evaluations, the compared methods run at their native strides, as most were developed for 30 FPS benchmarks, and DAM4SAM and HiM2SAM even adapt their stride to the benchmark frame rate, similarly to ours. The SAM 3 paper, however, reports only VOS results at s = 1 s=1 , so we also evaluate SAM 3 at s = 6 s=6 , both with its official strided variant and as our modification SAM 3 ours {}_{\text{ours}} , which pairs SAM 3’s selection rule with our stride. The former loses up to 10.9 points, while the latter gains 1.4 points on average. At equal stride, SAM3RL still outperforms SAM 3 ours {}_{\text{ours}} by 1.5 points on average.

paragraphs.en: Learned memory selection. SAM 3 admits only frames whose effective IoU score exceeds a threshold. Its bank thus acts as FIFO while the target is visible and, during absences, holds the pre-absence frames plus the most recent one. Figure 4 shows that SAM3RL instead spreads its bank further back in time and, during absences, mixes older pre-absence frames with ones from the absence itself. Unlike SAM 3, the policy admits nearly all medium-score frames and grows more selective as the score rises, rejecting the most confident frames about as often as those predicted absent; see Figure 4 . The policy also adapts to video content, admitting far more frames when the target moves or changes appearance, as in Figure 5 . Appendix F quantifies this effect and includes more behavior analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 已学习的记忆选择。 SAM 3 仅允许有效 IoU 分数超过阈值的关键帧。 因此，在目标可见期间，其缓冲区充当 FIFO；而在目标消失期间，则保留消失前的关键帧以及最新的关键帧。 图 4 显示，SAM3RL 则将缓冲区延伸至更早的时间点，并在目标消失期间将更旧的消失前关键帧与消失期间的关键帧混合使用。 与 SAM 3 不同，该策略几乎允许所有中等分数的关键帧，并且随着分数升高而变得更加选择性，拒绝最自信的关键帧的频率与预测为消失的关键帧大致相同；参见图 4。 该策略还会根据视频内容进行调整：当目标移动或外观发生变化时（如圖 5 所示），会允许更多关键帧。 附录 F 量化了这一效应，并包含了更多行为分析。

paragraphs.en: We presented SAM3RL, which learns memory control over a fixed-capacity bank with RL while keeping the backbone frozen. SAM3RL improves over SAM 3 on 11 of 12 benchmarks and ranks first on 10, with the largest gains on VOT(S), at virtually no runtime cost. It is also the only method that consistently improves on video object segmentation. Applying the same recipe to SAM 2 yields SAM2RL, which improves over SAM 2 on every benchmark and leads on 9. These results suggest that memory control should be learned rather than designed, as learned control improves even the strongest trackers and, unlike fixed rules, remains effective across model generations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SAM3RL，它通过强化学习在固定容量的内存库中学习记忆控制，同时保持主干网络冻结。 在 12 个基准测试中，SAM3RL 在 11 个上优于 SAM 3，并在 10 个中排名第一，其中在 VOT(S) 上的提升最大，且几乎不增加运行时成本。 它也是唯一一种能持续改进视频目标分割的方法。 将相同的方法应用于 SAM 2 可得到 SAM2RL，它在所有基准测试上均优于 SAM 2，并在 9 个中领先。 这些结果表明，记忆控制应通过学习而非设计来实现，因为经过学习的控制甚至能提升最强的追踪器，并且与固定规则不同，它能在不同模型版本中保持有效。

sents.en: Applying the same recipe to SAM 2 yields SAM2RL, which improves over SAM 2 on every benchmark and leads on 9.
sents.zh: 将相同的方法应用于 SAM 2 可得到 SAM2RL，它在所有基准测试上均优于 SAM 2，并在 9 个中领先。

sents.en: These results suggest that memory control should be learned rather than designed, as learned control improves even the strongest trackers and, unlike fixed rules, remains effective across model generations.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，记忆控制应通过学习而非设计来实现，因为经过学习的控制甚至能提升最强的追踪器，并且与固定规则不同，它能在不同模型版本中保持有效。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. First, the policy is tied to the 5 FPS decision rate seen in training. Deciding on every frame of 30 FPS benchmarks still improves over SAM 3, but the average gain drops from 2.9 to 1.8 points. We therefore match the training rate with the stride s s , which requires the frame rate to be known in advance and keeps the skipped frames out of the memory bank. The former is rarely restrictive in practice, as the frame rate is usually available. Training at the native rate would remove this restriction, but most decisions would then concern near-identical frames. Such a policy could nonetheless exploit the skipped frames and improve further on high-frame-rate benchmarks. Second, the policy controls only the seven frames in the memory bank, while the nine object pointers are filled by a fixed rule. Learning both jointly is a natural direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 首先，该策略与训练阶段所见的 5 FPS 决策速率绑定。 在每帧均为 30 FPS 的基准测试中做出决策，虽然仍优于 SAM 3，但平均增益从 2.9 分降至 1.8 分。 因此，我们将训练速率与步长 s s 相匹配，这要求提前知道帧率，并且能防止被跳过的帧进入内存库。 前者在实践中很少构成限制，因为帧率通常是已知的。 以原生速率进行训练将消除这一限制，但大多数决策届时将涉及几乎完全相同的帧。 尽管如此，这样的策略仍可以利用被跳过的帧，并在高帧率基准测试中取得进一步改进。 其次，该策略仅控制内存库中的七帧，而九个对象指针则通过固定规则填充。 将两者联合学习是未来工作的一个自然方向。

paragraphs.en: On the VOT(S) challenges and VOT datasets, SAM2RL improves over SAM 2 on all nine benchmarks and ranks first on five. The gains are largest on the challenges, where it is the best method on four of five and second only to SAMITE on VOT-LT 2021 {}_{\text{2021}} . On DiDi it is ahead of every hand-crafted rule, while on LaSOT and LaSOT ext {}_{\text{ext}} it trails SAMITE by less than one point. GOT-10k is the only tracking benchmark where the gain is negligible. SAM2RL also runs faster than SAM 2 itself and than every compared method, for the same reason as on SAM 3; see Section 4 . On the segmentation benchmarks, SAM2RL ranks first on all six. It is the only method that improves on DAVIS 2017 {}_{\text{2017}} . On YT-VOS 2019 {}_{\text{2019}} , it matches the baseline, as does SAM2Long, while every other rule falls below it. paragraphs.en: We score LaSOT and LaSOT ext {}_{\text{ext}} with the PyTracking evaluation code ( Danelljan et al., 2019 ) (commit 9cba77e ), which implements the AUC protocol of the official LaSOT toolkit ( Fan et al., 2019 ) . Our SAM 2.1 runs reproduce the published AUC of 70.0 on LaSOT and 56.9 on LaSOT ext {}_{\text{ext}} ( Ding et al., 2025b ; Videnović et al., 2026 ) to within 0.1. Some evaluators implement the protocol differently (e.g. , the got10k toolkit ( Huang et al., 2021 ) and the pysot toolkit ( Zhang et al., 2019a ) ), as does the evaluation code in the SAMURAI codebase ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . For instance, on LaSOT ext {}_{\text{ext}} , their implementations inflate scores of every method we report by up to 1.7 AUC compared to the official protocol. GOT-10k, MOSE v2 {}_{\text{v2}} , and all VOTS challenges are scored on their evaluation servers. DiDi and VOT-LT are scored with the VOT toolkit ( Čehovin Zajc, 2020 ) .

paragraphs.en: The SAM 3 video predictor offloads per-frame tracking state to pageable host memory with non_blocking=True and then reads that buffer on the CPU without synchronizing, which PyTorch documents as undefined behavior. Within a single add_new_points_or_box call, the asynchronous copy of the conditioning-frame mask is launched and the same tensor is interpolated on the host a few lines later. If the copy did not land, the host will read the leftovers of the previous sequence in the process. The corrupted mask is encoded into the memory bank as frame 0, and because long-term tracking never re-initializes, the sequence is lost from frame 1 rather than degrading over time. The failure requires box initialization, CPU state offloading, and a preceding sequence in the same process. We fix it by forcing CUDA → \rightarrow CPU copies to be synchronous.
paragraphs.zh: SAM 3 视频预测器通过 non_blocking=True 将每帧的跟踪状态卸载到可分页的主机内存中，随后在 CPU 上读取该缓冲区而不进行同步，而 PyTorch 将其文档化为未定义行为。 在单个 add_new_points_or_box 调用中，条件帧掩码的异步复制被启动，几行代码之后，同一张量又在主机上进行插值。 如果复制操作未完成，主机在此过程中将读取到前一个序列的残留数据。 损坏的掩码被编码为第 0 帧存入内存银行，并且由于长期跟踪从未重新初始化，因此从第 1 帧开始整个序列就会丢失，而不是随时间逐渐退化。 该故障需要框初始化、CPU 状态卸载以及同一进程中的前一个序列。 我们通过强制将 CUDA 到 CPU 的复制操作改为同步方式来修复此问题。

paragraphs.en: Batch composition. Each rank runs 64 parallel environments, each tracking one object. They come from 16 videos, with each object copied four times. paragraphs.en: Besides the seven memory features, the memory attention of SAM 2 and SAM 3 also reads up to sixteen object pointers, one of which always comes from the conditioning frame; see Section 3 . SAM 2 takes the remaining pointers from the 15 most recent frames, whereas SAM 3 takes them from the most recent frames whose effective IoU score exceeds a threshold, always including the previous frame. SAM3RL instead uses a recently evicted rule, which reads the pointers of the conditioning frame and of the six frames currently in the memory bank, and fills the remaining nine slots with the frames most recently evicted from the bank. We also consider a longest-kept rule, which ranks evicted frames by the number of decisions they remained in the memory bank and selects the pointers of the top nine. Unlike the rules of SAM 2 and SAM 3, both of our rules depend on the agent’s actions. Figure 7 compares all four rules within SAM3RL, reporting the LaSOT validation score of each rule every 25 training iterations; all other components are kept fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 除了七项记忆特征之外，SAM 2 和 SAM 3 的记忆注意力机制还会读取多达十六个对象指针，其中有一个始终来自条件帧；参见第 3 节。 SAM 2 从最近的 15 帧中获取其余的指针，而 SAM 3 则从有效 IoU 分数超过某一阈值的最近帧中获取，且始终包含前一帧。 SAM3RL 则采用一种近期驱逐规则：读取条件帧和当前处于记忆库中的六帧的指针，并将剩余九个槽位填充为最近从记忆中驱逐出的帧。 我们还考虑了一种最长保留规则：根据被驱逐帧在记忆库中停留的决定次数对其进行排序，并选择排名最高的九帧的指针。 与 SAM 2 和 SAM 3 的规则不同，我们提出的两种规则都依赖于智能体的动作。 图 7 比较了 SAM3RL 中的全部四种规则，每训练 25 次迭代便报告每种规则的 LaSOT 验证分数；所有其他组件均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: After the first 200 iterations, both our action-dependent rules remain above the SAM 2 and SAM 3 rules, showing that the object pointer selection rule affects tracking performance. Between the two, the recently evicted rule scores higher in most evaluations, but the longest-kept rule performs comparably and their seed bands overlap. Designing better rules could improve performance further. Moreover, since learned memory control outperforms hand-crafted rules for memory bank selection, extending the policy to also select object pointers is a natural direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 在前 200 次迭代之后，我们两个与动作相关的规则仍然优于 SAM 2 和 SAM 3 规则，这表明对象指针选择规则会影响跟踪性能。 在这两个规则中，最近被驱逐的规则在大多数评估中的得分更高，但保留时间最长的规则表现相当接近，且它们的种子带存在重叠。 设计更优的规则可以进一步提升性能。 此外，由于学习到的内存控制方法在内存银行选择方面优于人工设计的规则，因此将策略扩展至同时选择对象指针，是未来工作的一个自然方向。

paragraphs.en: We train SAM3RL against the normalized reward r t = q t − b t r_{t}=q_{t}-b_{t} , which is the difference between the tracking quality q t q_{t} of SAM 3 under our learned memory control and the tracking quality b t b_{t} of SAM 3 under its native memory control. Since much of the variance of q t q_{t} comes from the difficulty of the video rather than from the actions taken, subtracting the policy-independent b t b_{t} reduces this variance while leaving the optimal policy unchanged. paragraphs.en: Figures 11 , 12 and 13 compare the memory banks of SAM 3, DAM4SAM3, and SAM3RL around three absence gaps.
